caption:
One Pot Masala Khichdi Recipe 

This dish is definitely near and dear to my heart because of these reasons- comfort that it reminds me of home, simplicity of ingredients, ease because it’s so simple to make and comes together in minutes 

Ingredients: 
-1/2 cup rice + 1/2 cup dal (toor or moong), rinsed till water runs clear and then soaked for 30 minutes 
-1 onion, finely chopped
-1 tomato, finely chopped
-3 green chillies, finely chopped
-1/2 tsp haldi
-1/2 tsp red chilli powder
-salt, to taste
-around 500 - 600 ml water

For the tadka: 
Ghee (replace with oil to make this vegan) + jeera + mustard seeds + hing + red chilli powder
You can also use garlic, curry leaves

-Chopped coriander 

Method: 
-place all your ingredients in a pressure cooker and allow to cook for 3 whistles
-once the pressure is released from the cooker, make your tadka
-add all your tadka ingredients to a pan as shown in the video! 
-add to your khichadi and stir adding in your fresh coriander at the end
